name: leguin
method: Every one of the 679 kept rows was read (claim, quote, trueWording, verifier note). A VERIFIED grade was downgraded wherever the note itself states a MISMATCH between the claim and the page - an absent limb, a dropped hedge, a strengthened proposition, a gloss or attribution the page does not make, or a subject/scope shift - regardless of any excuse the verifier then offered. Notes that only record a locator, date, edition, orthography or source-field nuance, an elision that weakens or narrows the claim, or support carried by an adjacent sentence without a stated mismatch, were left standing. The VERIFIED_SUBSTANCE rows are the r9 finding on quotations read somewhere other than the cited URL; they are downgrades of VERIFIED_VERBATIM and are carried in `verdicts` so a merge applies them, even though the brief's enum named only PARTIAL/NOT_FOUND/CONTRADICTED.
